establishment.title: Establishment
establishment.description: Details, languages, theme, public page and pricing settings.

general.title: General details and languages
general.slugHint: Public page address: /b/<address>. Changing it breaks links already shared.
general.languagesHint: Enabled languages are offered on the public page and in emails; missing texts fall back to the default language.

publicPage.title: Public page and embedding
publicPage.description: Online bookings and websites allowed to embed the widget.
publicPage.bookingHint: When off, the public page only shows the contacts.
publicPage.originsHint: One origin per line. Empty: direct link and same domain only.

embed.iframe: Alternatively: iframe (only without online payment: after Stripe the customer does not come back to the widget)
embed.hint: Paste the code into your website; its domain must be among the allowed websites.
embed.title: Embed code
embed.description: Direct link and code to paste into your website.

theme.title: Public page theme
theme.description: Colours, font and texts; the preview updates while you edit.
theme.previewIntro: Pick dates, spot and package: booked in a minute.

fields.hide_header_in_embed: Hide the header when the page is embedded

warnings.primaryText: Primary colour contrast on white is {{ratio}}:1 (minimum 4.5:1): links and text will automatically use {{corrected}}.
warnings.accentContrast: The accent colour has {{ratio}}:1 contrast on white (minimum 3:1): selected spots may be hard to see.
warnings.similarColors: Primary and accent colours are too similar: choose more distinct colours.

pricingSettings.title: Pricing settings
pricingSettings.description: Values used by the pricing engine when a rule does not say otherwise.
pricingSettings.vatHint: Rate applied to packs without their own rate. Check with your accountant.

new.title: New establishment
new.description: Create another establishment of your organization.
new.ownerOnly: Only owners can create new establishments.
new.afterCreate: The guided setup opens after creation.

seasons.title: Seasons and periods
seasons.empty: No seasons: create one or use the guided setup.
seasons.deleteConfirm: Season {{year}} will be deleted with its rate periods.

periods.title: Rate periods {{year}}
periods.description: Low, mid, high season and peak: each day of the season belongs to at most one period.
periods.empty: No rate periods for this season.
periods.timeline: Calendar of the season's rate periods
periods.uncovered_one: {{count}} day of the season is not covered by any period.
periods.uncovered_other: {{count}} days of the season are not covered by any period.
periods.deleteConfirm: Period {{code}} will be deleted; rules using it will no longer apply.
periods.codeHint: low, mid, high, peak or a free code.
periods.rangesHint: One or more ranges between {{from}} and {{to}}.

holidays.title: Local holidays
holidays.description: Days treated as holidays by price rules (in addition to national holidays).
holidays.recurringHint: MM-DD format, e.g. 08-16 for the patron saint.

closures.title: Closures
closures.deleteConfirm: The closure of {{date}} will be deleted.
closures.formHint: Bad weather, events or works: spots cannot be booked in the selected slots.
closures.calendarHint: Click a day to add or edit a closure.
closures.pickDays: Select one or more days in the calendar.

zones.title: Zones
zones.description: Zones, assignment mode and online quotas.
zones.empty: No zones: create one or apply a template from the guided setup.
zones.priceCategoryHint: Key used by price rules, e.g. row1.
zones.autoAssignHint: On confirmation the system picks a free spot; otherwise staff assign it.

modeHints.seat: The customer picks the exact spot on the map.
modeHints.zone: The customer picks the zone; the spot is assigned later.
modeHints.quantity: Only a number of items, without position (e.g. free sunbeds).

quotaHints.percent: Share of spots that can be sold online (0–100).
quotaHints.count: Maximum number of spots that can be sold online.

pools.title: Pools
pools.systemHint: Created by the zone: edit it from the zone.
pools.overridesHint: Optional: a different capacity on some dates (e.g. extra sunbeds in August).

catalog.title: Catalogue
catalog.componentsHint: Physical items (umbrella, sunbed, deckchair). Tracked ones use a pool.

catalog.extrasHint: Optional additions to a pack or to the booking.
catalog.deleteConfirm: {{name}} will be removed from the catalogue.
catalog.trackedHint: Bookings use the availability of the chosen pool.
catalog.componentCodeHint: E.g. umbrella, sunbed, deckchair: the icon is picked from the code.
catalog.addToComposition: Add a component to the pack
catalog.noComponents: Create the components first in the Components tab.
catalog.extraComponentHint: Tracked component used by the extra, if any.

team.description: Users and roles of the establishment.

team.inviteHint: If the email already exists, the user only gets the new role.
team.removeConfirm: {{name}} will no longer be able to access this establishment.
team.createdExisting: {{name}} already had an account: they received the new role.
